info.title: egami
info.description: The egami command: convert, inspect, resize and edit images from a shell or a build script with Egami, a fully managed imaging library. Single commands, chained steps, JSON workflows and parallel batches.

commands.name: auto-orient
commands.description: Turn images upright from their EXIF orientation and reset it. A JPEG into a JPEG is turned losslessly.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare two images: print a metric and exit with 1 when they differ more than --threshold.

options.name: --metric
options.description: The number to print and test: ae (pixels that differ), mae, mse, rmse (the default), peak, psnr, ssim or dssim. [default: rmse]

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Exit with 1 when the metric is worse than this (above it, or below it for psnr and ssim); without it, any difference exits with 1.

options.name: --fuzz
options.description: How far apart two values may be and still count as equal, from 0 to 1, for ae and the exit code.

options.name: --diff
options.description: Write a picture of the differences.

options.name: --diff-style
options.description: highlight (differing pixels in red, as ImageMagick's compare) or absolute (|a - b|). [default: highlight]

options.name: --json
options.description: Write every metric per channel as JSON.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Serve egami's commands as tools to an AI assistant over the Model Context Protocol, on standard input and output. Tools read and write only inside the folders the assistant opened and those given with --allow, and never replace an input unless asked.

options.description: A folder the tools may read and write, besides the folders the assistant opened; give it once per folder. With neither, the working folder.

options.name: --max-inputs
options.description: The most files one tool call may take; 1000 by default. [default: 1000]
